text:
Maya: Ok team, lunchtime micro-challenge — caption this tragic scone I found on the counter. winner gets bragging rights and a virtual coffee :coffee: pic: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder
Samir: 'It graduated from crumb school.' :joy:
Noah: 'Scone: 1, Expectations: 0.'
Priya: 'When you apply for a job and only get half the offer.' :sweat_smile:
Jordan: 'Artisanal hole — minimalism, maximal crumbs.'
Maya: These are hilarious, keep 'em coming. also, quick poll: croissant or muffin to replace it? :thinking_face:
Samir: croissant. flaky diplomacy. :croissant:
Liam: muffin. solidarity with the underbaked. :raised_hands:
DevBot: Heads-up: kitchen rule reminder — label personal food if you don't want it claimed. (reaction: :thumbsup:)
Noah: Also, Maya — thanks for covering for me in the 2pm standup earlier. saved me from a very boring dentist chair story :pray:
Maya: anytime! happy to be the hero of small things. :sparkles:
Priya: final caption submission: 'Scone of four seasons: mostly crumbs, some regret.'
Jordan: winner by unanimous crumb count. :trophy:
